description: This dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings from 25 Parkinson's disease patients enrolled in a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial (NCT04110678) evaluating the neuroprotective potential of Neuroepo, a low-sialic-acid formulation of erythropoietin. EEG data were acquired at baseline and six months post-treatment, with both qualitative clinical assessment and quantitative source-level analysis using VARETA and MNI atlas co-registration. The dataset supports investigation of EEG biomarkers for disease progression and treatment response in Parkinson's disease.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG recordings were obtained before and six months after drug administration. Qualitative EEG analysis was performed by two independent experts using a Likert-type scale. Quantitative EEG analysis employed source localization using VARETA software with Montreal Neurological Institute Atlas co-registration. Statistical analysis between sources utilized permutation testing and contrast methods with Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.
